content: tldraw SDK latest is 5.1.1 but uses a dual license: free for non-commercial (hobby) with a mandatory 'made with tldraw' watermark, and REQUIRES a valid license key in production (HTTPS, non-localhost, NODE_ENV=production) or it will not render. This conflicts with a pure FREE/OSS static-deploy constraint, so tldraw is NOT recommended; use Konva.js (MIT) for the canvas editor instead.
